LanguageData.NMC_Text0307: Hello, commander. The manifest is ready. What would you like to bring to the colony today?
LanguageData.NMC_Text0308: Welcome back. I'll keep you company while you browse. Take your time.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0309: Mothership supply channel connected. Browse the stock and take home whatever suits you.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0310: Have you eaten properly today? However long the shopping list gets, remember to rest.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0311: It's quiet aboard the mothership. I enjoy hearing about everyday life in the colony.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0312: Leave some room in the warehouse. When supplies arrive, you won't have to move boxes in a hurry.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0313: Should I bring everyone sweets the next time we dock?
LanguageData.NMC_Text0314: When the weather is good, look up at the sky for me. The view from the ground is so different from orbit.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0315: Between sorting supplies, I read a little. Any stories you've enjoyed lately?
LanguageData.NMC_Text0316: Don't worry, I'll stay on this channel. Take your time.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0317: A lamp, a hot meal. Sometimes little things make us feel safe.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0318: Order received. Goods will arrive from orbit. Leave space in the warehouse.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0319: I've arranged these for you. I hope they'll be useful.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0320: Supplies are with the delivery system. Remember to rest when you're done.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0321: Purchase complete. Once the crates land, we'll see what else you need.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0322: Thank you. These supplies will keep helping aboard the mothership.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0323: Donation received and P points credited. Thank everyone who carried it for me.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0324: Spare supplies help too. Thank you for thinking of the mothership.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0325: All received. Doesn't more warehouse space feel a little better?
LanguageData.NMC_Text0326: The new manifest is here. I've sorted the categories. See if you need anything.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0327: Stock just updated. What good things will we find this time?
LanguageData.NMC_Text0328: This order hasn't gone through yet. Check the message; we'll fix it before continuing.
LanguageData.NMC_Text0329: No rush. Check the quantities and P points. I'll wait.

LanguageData.NMC_Text0753: Only player-owned ships from this mod can fold
LanguageData.NMC_Text0754: Wait for takeoff, landing or entry warp to finish
LanguageData.NMC_Text0755:
Fold the ship into a clear position inside the current energy field. Retains the hull, rotation, cargo, passengers and upgrade progress; carriers recover their fighters first. Unavailable during takeoff, landing or entry warp. Summoned fleets retain their original lifetime.
Warping uses the Nivarian building printing effect: 4 seconds at departure, then 4 seconds at the actual arrival position (game time). Damage applies normally during both phases.
Airborne ships can warp above terrain or buildings and remain airborne. Grounded ships still require a valid ground destination.
LanguageData.NMC_WarpFieldStatus: Energy field: radius 6; personnel warp destination
LanguageData.NMC_WarpLocked: Switch to flight mode first. Movement, landing and ship warp are unavailable while deployed or changing mode.
LanguageData.NMC_WarpModeDescription: Switch modes in 1 second. The deployed prism hovers and slowly rotates, providing power, unit charging and personnel arrivals within 6 cells. Fields on one map share a 10,000 W budget. Hovering consumes flight fuel; ships cannot warp to prisms.
LanguageData.NMC_WarpTakeoffFirst: Take off and finish ascending first.
LanguageData.NMC_WarpDestinationLost: The destination prism is inactive, out of fuel or has moved. Select a destination again.
LanguageData.NMC_WarpRecallDescription:
Warp to the primary field or a deployed prism, including across maps. Equipment and inventory travel with the colonist; carried loads are dropped and current work ends.
Warping uses the Nivarian building printing effect: 4 seconds at departure, then 4 seconds at the actual arrival position (game time). Damage applies normally during both phases.
LanguageData.NMC_WarpBusy: Warping (4-second departure and 4-second arrival); damage still applies
LanguageData.NMC_StormAttackDesc: Designate a hostile target within 100 cells. Fires every 3 seconds: 20 direct damage at 80% armor penetration, then a 3×3 blast for 15 damage at 35% penetration. Both deal 5× damage to buildings.
LanguageData.NMC_StormMustFly: Must be in flight and not currently warping
LanguageData.NMC_StormAutoDesc: Automatically attack visible hostiles in range while airborne. Explicit targets remain active when this is off.
LanguageData.NMC_StormClearDesc: Clear the manually designated target. Automatic targeting continues if fire at will is enabled.
LanguageData.NMC_SageAttackModeDesc: When airborne, engage ground enemies within 12 cells. Fire two beams every 0.5 seconds, each dealing 6 damage with 30% armor penetration. Each volley costs 1 chemfuel, even after the battery upgrade. Detection remains active when weapons are off.
LanguageData.NMC_SageTargetDesc: Prioritize a ground enemy within 12 cells; acquire another if it becomes invalid. Flying and gravity-lifted targets are excluded.
LanguageData.NMC_SageMustAttack: Take off and enable attack mode; unavailable during warp.
LanguageData.NMC_SageStatus: Attack mode: {0}; passive detection radius: 50 cells
LanguageData.NMC_Text0818: The Continuum defenders and defenses have been cleared, but the Continuum communications core still stands. The mission is not complete. Click this message to locate the core and manually order your troops or ships to attack it. Destroy it before leaving.
